# Hello, World!

Welcome to modern technical documentation with Markdown.

## Contributing Guidelines

1. Fork the repository and create a feature branch.
2. Ensure all tests pass with `pnpm test`.
3. Keep commits atomic and adhere to Conventional Commits standard.
For full technical governance details, please review [AGENTS.md](file:///AGENTS.md).

- [x] Setup SvelteKit 3 static adapter
- [x] Configure Tailwind CSS v4 via pure CSS
- [x] Lock Skeleton UI v5.0.1
- [ ] Expand quote content packs across world languages

### Footnotes & References

Here is a reference point[^1] to the Unix philosophy.

[^1]: Eric S. Raymond, *The Art of Unix Programming*, 2003.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Skeleton UI is locked to version 5.0.1. Downgrading to v2 or v3 is strictly forbidden.

| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `pnpm typecheck` | Svelte & TypeScript check | 0 errors, 0 warnings |
| `pnpm lint` | Architecture boundary validation | 0 errors |
| `pnpm test` | Complete Vitest suite | 100% passing |
